//: Golden contract for the benchmark metrics. 'goldens' are keyed per reference setup ('any' = hardware-independent, e.g. deterministic bundle bytes or structural frame counts). Values are recorded by tool/check_goldens.dart --record after a drive run and compared by --check (the bench-core CI). References get a fresh entry per new setup (see 'references').

references.vm_debug: local flutter test VM, debug build — sanity reference only, not a contract
references.android: the canonical contract reference — recorded from the first emulator run (API 36, 2026-09)

memory_idle.unit: bytes heap drift after finish vs idle (0 = fully released; VM service via --no-dds)

memory_active.unit: bytes heap delta idle → active step (the overlay's real weight; VM service via --no-dds)

native_size.unit: bytes hintful adds to a release Android AOT snapshot (analyze-size, package:hintful subtree)
native_size.note: Deterministic per SDK + ABI: measured on Flutter 3.47.0, android-x64 (2026-09-02). Re-record only when the SDK or engine code changes.

bundle_delta.unit: bytes added to the startup bundle
bundle_delta.note: Deterministic per SDK: measured on Flutter 3.47.0 (2026-09-02). Re-record only when the SDK or engine code changes. Deferred-engine target (N7) is 0 bytes — re-key then.
